purpose.domain_detail: Web/CGI template engine: reads a web page definition file, processes HTML templates with variable substitution ({NAME} placeholders and <COBOL>VAR</COBOL> tags), and outputs HTML via the COBW3 web framework
purpose.summary: MAKEFORM is a COBOL-based HTML template processor/form generator. It reads a web page script file (ARKWEB), opens named HTML template files under a TEMPLATE\ directory, substitutes named parameters and COBOL data variables into the template, and writes the resulting HTML output via the COBW3_PUT_TEXT web interface. It supports debug mode, table-section filtering, and multi-pass template expansion.

notable_features: COBW3 web CGI linkage section (COBW3_PUT_TEXT CALL)
14 COPY statements for modular file definitions
FUNCTION UPPER-CASE / FUNCTION LOWER-CASE intrinsic functions
Template variable substitution using {NAME} and <COBOL>VAR</COBOL> syntax
DECLARATIVES section with USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR
INSPECT TALLYING / REPLACING for string parsing
88-level condition names for SW-TABLE and DEBUG flags
